entities.summary: Dale Harris Van Sickel was an American college football, basketball and baseball player during the 1920s. He later became a Hollywood motion picture actor and stunt performer for over forty years. Van Sickel played college football for the University of Florida, and was recognized as the first-ever first-team All-American in the history of the Florida Gators football program.
